messages:
Marta V: opened PR with SDK migration guide + an example that accidentally includes a real log snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2280
Ravi P: which file/line? I can take a quick pass.
Marta V: docs/guides/sdk-migration.md around the section 'auth flow' 1. theres a pasted customer header. needs redaction -> synthetic example.
Sam K: I can redact and replace with placeholders (<SERVICE>, <ORG>). will push a tiny commit.
LegalBot: Flagged: docs/guides/sdk-migration.md contains potential customer-identifying data. Legal approval required and an audit entry must be added to the PR.
ci-bot: preview build failed: docs-lint error (line 142): broken anchor reference. Full log: https://ci.internal/preview/2280/logs
Ravi P: Ill fix the anchor while Sam swaps the snippet.
Sam K: pushed commit d4a9cbe with synthetic snippet and added comment <!-- redacted:audit-id=REPLACE_ME --> in file. preview: https://ci.internal/preview/2280/d4a9cbe
ci-bot: preview rebuilt for PR 2280 at 1980012380 1 status: lint OK, link check failed (anchor mismatch).
Ravi P: fixed anchor path (was ../references/auth.md#token -> ../references/auth.md#token-exchange). pushed e1b2f9.
SecurityBot: quick security review done. placeholders look good, remove any exact timestamps and user IDs. provisional security thumbs-up.
Marta V: removed timestamps and UIDs, replaced with <TIMESTAMP> and <USER_ID>. updated PR description with legal contact.
LegalBot: Legal review requested by @Marta V. Standard turnaround 24-48 hours. If this blocks a release, provide business justification and tag @release-team.
Marta V: tagging release-team: this touches docs referenced by the upcoming SDK patch; request expedited legal review.
release-team: noted. prefer not to block the SDK release. options: (1) hold merge until legal approves, (2) merge with private flag and redact further, (3) ship SDK and follow up with docs-only patch. Recommend option 3 unless legal objects.
Sam K: agree. we can add label `merge-hold: legal` and set milestone for docs sprint if legal needs more time.
Marta V: adding label and milestone. also added Legal contact: legal@redwood.ai in PR body and a short business justification for expedited review.
LegalBot: Reminder: please paste contact person + email and a brief justification in PR for expedited review.
Marta V: done (contact: priya@redwood.ai; justification: small docs change required for SDK 1.3 release).
SecurityBot: final note: ensure the synthetic snippet includes deterministic outputs and no real-looking hashes.
Sam K: adjusted snippet to use clear placeholders and an explanatory note about redaction.
ci-bot: final preview OK at 1980012399 1 status: all checks passed.
release-team: we'll proceed with SDK release plan; if legal signs off within 24h, we can unblock merge. otherwise keep `merge-hold: legal` and ship SDK without docs change, then merge docs later.
Marta V: thanks everyone 1 Ill keep this thread updated on legal signoff. :pray:
